subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: Should this broad native-Linux VPS performance request become a scoped runbook/instrumentation plan, or should maintainers close/split it into the narrower latency trackers already open?
rationale: The repository can show partial diagnostics and overlapping trackers, but code review cannot choose the measurement environment, acceptable estimate quality, or whether the umbrella issue should remain open.

options.title: Scope a native-Linux runbook
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella for a bounded VPS runbook and use related issues for measured code changes.

options.title: Split into existing trackers
options.body: Close or supersede this issue only after maintainers confirm that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88812, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78861, and related slices fully cover the desired outcome.

options.title: Wait for fresh traces
options.body: Defer work until a maintainer or reporter captures current-main traces from a comparable native Linux VPS.

recommendation.title: Scope a native-Linux runbook
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella for a bounded VPS runbook and use related issues for measured code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-source and docs routing evidence points to steipete as the best available owner for deciding whether this remains an umbrella runbook or is split into focused trackers.
